rulesTestNames: keeps the founding-host offer config, organizer places and owner guards server-only
owner: Admin Owner through adminManageFoundingHostOffers (cap, deadline); the founding place grant (takenCount)
read: server only; adminManageFoundingHostOffers, the founding place grant and its daily reconcile
write: adminManageFoundingHostOffers: expected-revision replacement of cap and deadline with a reason and an admin audit log, never below takenCount. The founding place grant increments takenCount in the transaction that creates the place, so the cap is never exceeded
migrationNotes: New collection (owner decision 16 Nov 2026). Absent until the owner opens a city; no backfill. Organizers that gained an owner before a city opened are not founding hosts.
